dimensions.criterion: For every emitted record (all fixture jobs + every real job in the run), `maker.startedAt` = the call logger's request-send time (`sent_at`, written by `freeze/harness/or_call.py`) of the **first** Maker call and `producedAt` = its reply-receive time (`received_at`) of the **last** Maker call, read from the Maker harness log and compared at whole seconds UTC. Equal only if that log's send and receive times are equal. A Maker call logged without both times fails. Fixture `single-call` (one Maker call, send ≠ receive) is in every run. (Amendment 1.)

separationGaps: Grokbot's underlying model(s) are not disclosed by its operator; family and identifier recorded as undisclosed.

The Maker's calls were issued by a harness operator, the E-DI Maker bot (a Grok Bot). The operator only issued the logged calls and applied returned patches verbatim (custody/method.md). This was instructed, not enforced.

Controls and fixtures were held outside the Maker's and Evaluator's working trees with sha256 committed at freeze, but on a shared box both bots could technically read them; non-reading was instructed, not enforced.
Held-out control case files are digested from /workspace/next-job-controls, outside the repo. The record carries their sha256 only, so a stranger cannot re-read the cases.

The E-GLM harness logs in the repo are redacted of held-out control text (handoffs/redact_glm_log.py). The full log's sha256 is in custody/evidence/harness-eval-glm-b4.log.full.sha256, and the full log stays outside the repo.
S1 is a script with no call log. Its pass and control time (2026-10-28T14:13:53Z) was entered by hand from the modification time of the sealed batch-4 s1/summary.json.

After the freeze, the generation, amendment, evaluation and dispose lines in inputs/custody-events.jsonl were appended by hand by the Orchestrator, not stamped by custody_ledger.py. The dispose line carries the Owner's decision time and channel as the Orchestrator received them.
